title: THE AIR STRIKE, POWER-UPS, MEDALS AND HAUL HAVE SOUNDS
why: His order of 2026-10-15: add the sounds. Calling the air strike now plays a target lock, a radio squelch and two low confirm pulses, the strike craft comes in over you with a rising roar for the 1.5 seconds before the first blast, and each of the six blasts is a recorded blast at its own pitch with a sub drop instead of the plain boom. Each power-up has its own drop sound, pickup sound, last-three-seconds tick, end sound and bubble hit. The kill medals are one low climbing pop per tier: the streak medals (DOUBLE KILL up to UNSTOPPABLE) climb in five steps, and the style medals sound by the tier of their plate. They replace the old thin chime ladder and notes. The golden enemy gets a low three-bell sound when it is gilded, and each item of the haul reveal ticks with a soft tock that climbs with its rarity. No words, no voices, no music.
now: The air strike, power-ups, medals, golden enemy and haul reveal have their own dark sounds, and the old thin chimes are gone.
